title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Site Board. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Site Board
options.lineage: Project information boards bolted to every construction site hoarding
options.thesis: His page is the board outside the site: every claim a numbered, labelled field you can read from the footpath.
options.viewport: A yellow board with a black frame fills the screen: (1) name of engineer, huge; (2) discipline; (3) ₱1B+ ICLS, licence, base; the site photo and a blue 'Contact the engineer' panel sit beside it.
options.risk: Turns into a hi-vis costume if every section becomes a sign; yellow must stay on the boards, with quiet hoarding between.

raised.raise: Every field numbered (1) (2) (3) in a strict margin column, like the Program of Work he files.
One statement per panel; hierarchy carried by panel size and colour, frame bars drawn at true thickness.
Each project board: image band across the top, facts in hard columns beneath.
Every project board shares one anatomy, so the run of boards reads like a ruler.

options.label: Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: A1 engineering drawing sheets with border grid and title block
options.thesis: The portfolio as a sheet in his drawing set: title block holds who he is, revision table holds his career.
options.viewport: A bordered sheet with grid references; his name as the drawing title, a title block down the right with project, licence and contact, a red revision cloud circling ₱1B+.
options.risk: The most familiar engineering-portfolio look, and close to what the page already is.

options.label: Evidence Index
options.thesis: Every document, photo and credential visible at once in one ruled mosaic of red-tabbed modules.
options.viewport: A packed grid: name module, site photo, licence, ₱1B+, BOQ, POW, take-off and plan thumbnails, contact, all in one screen.
options.case: Wins on clarity (all evidence in one scan), loses on audience: UK and Australian reviewers don't read this density as engineering.
options.risk: Overwhelming on a phone, the opposite of the minimalism you asked for.

options.label: Orizuru Sequence
options.thesis: Career shown as a fold sequence.
options.viewport: One sheet folding step by step.
options.case: Hiring engineers don't identify with paper folding; it obscures the facts.
options.kept: Strict numbered margin column for fields.

options.label: Glazier Partition
options.thesis: Sections as panes in a black glazing grid.
options.case: Elegant but reads as architecture/interiors, not civil delivery.
options.kept: One statement per panel; frame bars at true thickness.

options.label: Calavera Broadside
options.thesis: Career as a shouting news sheet.
options.case: Wrong register for a candidate's evidence.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Skills as needles on a meter bridge.
options.case: Audio world, no tie to construction; meters invite fake skill levels.
options.kept: Identical modules repeated as a ruler.

options.label: Datamatics
options.case: Art-world abstraction; reviewers need plain facts.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean modern engineer's portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and roles beside a site photo, key numbers below, projects as case studies.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other portfolios by design.
